title: STARTTLS: add to CAPABILITIES and implement command handler in reader
description: Wire STARTTLS into the reader NNTP session. When [tls] cert_path and key_path are configured, add STARTTLS to the CAPABILITIES response. On STARTTLS command: reply 382, perform tokio-rustls handshake on the existing TCP stream, reset session state on success, close on failure. After upgrade, remove STARTTLS from CAPABILITIES. Return 502 if already TLS. Blocked on: stoa-74b386c0.
